verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs list Authenticator application (TOTP) and Backup codes as enableable second-factor strategies, and sign-in returns needs_second_factor when MFA is enabled. The changelog documents a customizable reverification window for sensitive actions, which is step-up enforcement. missing for 10: explicit documentation that MFA can be made mandatory for all users, in-depth step-up/reverification docs beyond a changelog line, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can require multi-factor authentication with TOTP authenticator apps and backup codes, with step-up enforcement where needed

citations.quote: Clerk allows you to enable the following second factor strategies: - MFA: - SMS verification code - Authenticator application - Backup codes
If you have multi-factor authentication (MFA) enabled for your application, the sign-in attempt will return a status of needs_second_factor.
Customize the reverification window: Control how recently users must have authenticated before performing sensitive actions.
